_schema._about: Content for /book, rendered by tools/render_rights_work_book.py (CSS 45-book.css, JS 45-book.js). One column, calendar first: a slim header (lockup left, the contact email right), the h1, the sub and the facts, then the cal.com embed loading immediately (no click gate, no form before it, no cookie gate), then what the call covers and what happens after booking beside the founder quote, then the privacy note and the rights as plain text. No countdown, no seals, no photography. British English. SPEC §6.7.
_schema.header: {logo:{file, alt, href}, right:{label, href}} - the reference had a timer at the right; we put the contact email there.
_schema.left: {h1, sub, embed:{provider, url, src, title, theme, layout, height_min, note, fallback:{label, href}}, expect:{label, items[]}, privacy:{text, link_label, href}, facts_label, facts[], creator:{text, link_label, href}, after:{label, items[]}} - embed.src is the exact iframe src and embed.title its accessible name. It has its own dark theme and must never be colour-inverted or restyled. cal.com loads only on this page. sub is the canonical call promise (SPEC §6.6), lightly adapted; never promise a written plan, free hooks, a reply time or 'the person who'll run your account'.
_schema.right: {background:{kind, note}, quote:{text, name, role, signature, mark}, ships_to:{label, items:[{id, text}]}, rights:{label, items:[{id, label}]}} - background.kind = 'plain': the founder quote sits on plain black with a subtle jam radial glow drawn in CSS (SPEC S5). Never a frame from any clip and never an image. quote is the founder's own statement (identical to home.json quotes.items[0].text and agency.json founder.quote). No portrait until a real photo of Avi exists. rights items render as plain text; no seal files, badges or marks (DMCC Act 2024 Sch. 20 para 3). ships_to is kept for reference and is not rendered.
_schema.dropped: The reference's reserved-time countdown and the four form fields (first name, last name, work email, company website) are intentionally absent; the calendar collects those.

meta.title: Book a 30-minute call with Avi | hypjam
meta.description: Book a free 30-minute call with Avi, hypjam's founder, on Google Meet. Packages from £1,800 a month; first cuts 14 days after a signed brief.

left.sub: Free, on Google Meet. Tell us what you're launching and who it's for. You'll leave knowing whether UGC suits it, which formats we'd test first and why, and what your first month would cost. If another route suits you better, we'll say so.
